target: किराया बढ़ने पर हम दूसरे घर में चले गए।

target: बात से मुकर जाना उसकी पुरानी आदत है।

english: I called back the person who had called.

target: आप आ रहे हैं या नहीं, कृपया पहले से बता दीजिए।
english: Please let us know in advance whether you're coming.

english: Vikas flatly refused to come.

english: This necklace looks really good on you.

english: As soon as I left the office, I called you.

english: I'm going to the market right now, do you need anything?

target: पहले मैं दफ़्तर के पास ही रहता था।
english: I used to live right near the office.

target: दादी, आप आराम कीजिए, चाय मैं बना देती हूँ।
english: Grandma, you rest, I'll make the tea.

target: गौरव जी, आप कहें तो हम शुरू करते हैं।
english: Gaurav ji, if you say so, we'll start.

english: The moment he saw me, his face went pale.

target: रोज़ थोड़ी देर टहलने से तबीयत ठीक रहती है।
english: Walking a little every day keeps you in good health.

english: The market in this area is famous for its clothes.

target: तुम रोज़ कसरत करते हो, तभी इतने फ़िट हो।
english: You work out every day, that's why you're so fit.
